sources.title: UFC 330 Islam Makhachev vs Ian Garry | Full Card Breakdown Predictions & More
UFC Community Live Stream - Early Leans and Picks Islam vs Ian Garry Part 2
UFC 330: Makhachev vs Garry | Main Card Picks #ufc330 #ufc #fightpicks #ufcpicks
UFC 330: Makhachev vs Garry | Full Card Predictions & Breakdown
My Final Predictions For UFC 330: Islam Makhachev VS Ian Machado Garry

fights.display: Ian Machado Garry vs Islam Makhache

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: One of his most confident favorites on the card: Makhachev has passed every test, is durable without the weight cut, and Garry's year with Oliveira won't be enough.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Makhachev in the main event.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Believes Makhachev can take Garry down repeatedly and control/submit him, with wrestling and BJJ a level above Rakhmonov's, though he's nervous about Garry's size, range and mobility; leaning submission or decision.

options.selection: Islam Makhachev by submission in round 4

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Makhachev has solved every advantage Garry has before (size, reach, boxing), is elite in scrambles with the d'arce and back takes, and Garry can't finish him or out-decision him with Khabib game-planning.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Nobody defends Makhachev's takedowns and Garry lacks one-punch power, so Garry would have to win a decision; Makhachev drags him late for a finish.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects the win most likely by submission.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leaning toward a finish, expecting Makhachev to find submission openings on the ground since Garry's BJJ shouldn't pose problems for him.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Expects Makhachev to get takedowns, dominate and submit Garry's long neck.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Ochoa to beat Johnson in the featured fight.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Ochoa is the younger, active, intense striker with decent takedown defense; sees it as a passing of the torch over the 36-year-old Johnson.

options.selection: Jose Ochoa by KO/TKO in round 2

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Vowed never to pick Johnson again; Johnson is hittable to the left hook and starts slow, while Ochoa has crisp boxing and in his view beat Alibayev.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Ochoa's rare power at 125 will get Johnson's respect, Johnson is coming off a bad KO loss and fighting too often, and he won't offensively wrestle Ochoa.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects the win most likely by KO.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Ochoa is dangerous, technical with solid takedown defense; Johnson has absorbed damage with little time off, though Johnson at +300 is too big a dog and odds should be closer.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Thinks Johnson has enough left to survive to the final bell while Ochoa lands more, winning a 30-27 damage-based decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Robertson's takedowns are still weak and she gave up reversals to Lemos; Dern is far higher-level on the ground and he prefers her striking and chin too.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Dern in the co-main event.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Bad stylistic matchup for Robertson: Dern is dangerous on the ground and clearly more technical and dangerous on the feet, so if Robertson can't dominate with wrestling she loses; borderline confident-picks-list addition possibly in a two-legger.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Dern's improved striking wins the exchanges while the grappling cancels out; as an experienced champ ahead on the cards she won't risk chasing a finish.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects the win most likely by decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Expects a finish inside three and a half rounds and leans submission since that is Dern's wheelhouse.

options.selection: Mackenzie Dern by KO/TKO in round 4

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Dern is better everywhere: good takedown defense, improved striking and elite jiu-jitsu, while Robertson is one-dimensional with abysmal striking, and Robertson is only a +190 dog.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Magny has seven submission losses and his long limbs make him susceptible to chokes; Brahimaj is younger and a jiu-jitsu specialist.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Thinks Brahimaj is overrated with wins only over cans, while Magny has huge height/reach, experience and a grappling edge and can pick him apart off the back foot for a decision.

options.selection: Ramiz Brahimaj by submission in round 1

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Even-odds fight but he favors Brahimaj's explosiveness and quick finishing ability, and Magny has repeatedly gotten into bad grappling spots and been submitted recently.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Official prediction is Brahimaj via submission in round one or two given Magny's history of early submission losses.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Brahimaj only wins by submission and usually in round one, and Magny has always struggled with submission defense; the fight is either a Brahimaj finish or a Magny decision.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects Magny to keep it standing, use his length and win rounds on the outside rather than finish.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Stated as his main card pick to defeat Barboza.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Barboza is 40 and has absorbed massive damage recently; Ribovics is durable, high-volume and pressuring, so he expects a punches-in-bunches breakdown finish.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Ribovics' pressure, volume and power should overwhelm a 40-year-old Barboza who has taken a lot of damage; no specific round given since it could come in any of the three.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects the win to come most likely by KO.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Barboza has taken too much damage and looked bad recently; Ribovics pressuring forward should get the KO, though Ribovics is open on the feet so it isn't a confident-list pick.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Barboza can't take a shot at 40 coming off the Turner KO, but Ribovics is a volume guy without much knockout power, so he expects Ribovics to beat him up over a decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Athletic freak with reach and better wrestling against a middle-of-the-road middleweight; expects him to take Stoltzfus down and smash him early despite the high price.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Abdul-Malik to defeat Stoltzfus.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Says he isn't super confident but Abdul-Malik is younger, more physical, with height, reach and power advantages over a hittable Stoltzfus.

options.selection: Mansur Abdul-Malik by KO/TKO in round 1 or 2

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Abdul-Malik is better technically on the feet, far more powerful and explosive, and his takedown defense removes Stoltzfus's best weapon; very confident.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Abdul-Malik's power and brutal ground and pound against Stoltzfus' bad chin, poor striking defense and poor takedown defense should equal a knockout.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects the win most likely by KO.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Calls Fernando a special talent with huge reach, fast varied striking; expects him to stop the takedowns and knock Tobias out early.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Fernando is a massive LFA double champion with power and better level of competition, and Tobias struggles on the feet and plods around, so he expects a first-round knockout.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Thinks the fight should be even odds and Tobias is value, but ultimately Fernando is the more complete, technical and versatile striker; explicitly a low confidence pick.

options.selection: Lucas Fernando by finish in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Fernando's speed, power and investment in the body and legs will overwhelm Tobias, who he thinks is stiff, unathletic and simply not good.

options.selection: Joel Alvarez by submission or ground-and-pound TKO

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Alvarez has a ~95% finish rate and is dangerous everywhere; Njokuani can't grapple and got hit repeatedly by lesser strikers like Carlos Leal.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Njokuani has a poor record against grapplers and Alvarez has a huge grappling advantage; if he uses the wrestling he could finish early in round one or two.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Alvarez is the younger, far better boxer with underrated jiu-jitsu; expects a knockout inside two rounds or a submission, with Njokuani weak in boxing defense.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Njokuani is a striker who struggles badly once the fight hits the mat and has a poor get-up game, while Alvarez is a prolific early submission finisher.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Doesn't fully trust Turner's comeback after his early retirement, and Fernandes is solid, well-rounded and mixes in takedowns well; likely decision or late TKO, but a lower confidence pick.

options.selection: Jalin Turner by KO/TKO in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Turner is the side whenever he faces a non-wrestler, he's enormous for 155, his fights rarely leave round one, and the odds are close.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Medium confidence: Turner is a gifted, huge, hard-hitting lightweight and Fernandes' opposition wouldn't beat him; a naked leg kick could get him cracked early.

options.selection: Jalin Turner by first round finish

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Suggested as a hedge alongside the Fernandes moneyline since Turner is the bigger, more dangerous finisher.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Johnson's explosiveness, power and speed should matter in the striking exchanges and get an early finish, but McConico is the more technical guy and very live as a dog; low to mid confidence.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Johnson's boxing is his real skill set and McConico hates being backed up and hit; the worry is Johnson's terrible fight IQ leading him to wrestle again.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: McConico has good takedown defense and is strong in early rounds, which is Johnson's only window to win; expects a decision, maybe a split.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Doesn't like Luque's move up to 185 at age 35 after recent poor showings, while Gore is the bigger man and dangerous with front chokes.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Low confidence play; believes Luque is battle-worn, doesn't wear damage well and has no wins at middleweight, while Gore is the stronger, more willing man.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Predicts Luque shoots a bad takedown and Gore lands another standing guillotine, having already got three in the UFC.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: A 50/50 fight where he takes the underdog: Luque is arguably better everywhere technically and if he hurts his opponent he'll likely club-and-sub with a front choke, though he's worried about Luque's durability.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Luque has taken huge damage and had a brain injury, and no longer absorbs punches like he used to; Gorimbo's striking should finish him, though the capper dislikes taking Gorimbo as a favorite.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Calls it the easiest pick on the card: Orolbai is far better on the ground, has wins over ranked opposition, and Wells will get taken down and submitted or rocked into a panic takedown into a d'arce.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Wells won't handle Orolbai's grappling as the fight wears on; Orolbai has the edge in both striking volume/technique and wrestling, so he should reach a dominant position and find the sub.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: On a three-fight win streak at 170 with wrestling pace and pressure, while Wells is nearly 40 and had been on a losing skid; he can take damage and keep coming.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Expects the wrestling and grappling output to lead to a submission finish in round two or three.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Urbay is the better wrestler (19 takedowns vs Chris Curtis) and Wells isn't enough of a submission threat; Urbay has been finding second-round submissions.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Won't back a 5'8" fighter at 185; Johnson has been trapped in wrestling positions before, so he expects Nolan to extend the fight and outgrapple him.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Turner's experience against elite lightweights, size and power at 155 outweigh Fernandez's wins over weak opposition; expects a close decision.
